Duplexes and half duplexes in North Delta
Local rules that affect duplexes in North Delta

items.t: SSMUH position (Delta): Duplexes are the baseline form under the provincial framework, and Delta's are express: SSMUH is permitted on all single-detached and duplex lots citywide under Delta's SSMUH amendments (Bylaws 8394 + 8395, adopted June 24, 2024), allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies. SSMUH is added-unit potential on an existing lot, not a subdivision right — confirm the parcel's zone and eligibility before pricing in added-unit potential.

faq.q: Can I add units to a North Delta duplex lot?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH Bylaws 8394 + 8395 (adopted June 24, 2024) permit small-scale multi-unit housing on single-detached and duplex lots citywide, in combinations of detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies. That is added-unit potential on the existing lot, not a subdivision right — confirm the parcel's zone first.

faq.q: What does the North Delta market look like overall?
faq.a: In September 2026, North Delta recorded 209 detached listings with 24 sales at a $1,100,000 median (39 days on market), and 71 Condos & Townhomes listings with 8 sales at a $622,500 median (48 days) — community-level figures, which is the level this whole-community page covers (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are in North Delta?
faq.a: SD37 schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Annieville, Devon Gardens, Brooke, Gibson, Hellings, Jarvis Traditional, McCloskey, Gray, Chalmers, Richardson, Heath, Sunshine Hills, Cougar Canyon and Pinewood elementaries, and North Delta, Sands, Delview, Burnsview and Seaquam secondaries — catchments are address-based, so confirm the exact address with the district.
